svg.aria-label: Project 01: Containerized Web Application Deployment on Amazon EKS Fargate with GitHub Actions CI/CD
svg.title: Project 01: Containerized Web Application Deployment on Amazon EKS Fargate with GitHub Actions CI/CD
svg.text: Deployment on Amazon EKS Fargate with
Replace hands-on deployments with a push-to-deploy pipeline: parallel image
builds, ECR push, manifest apply and rollout verification on EKS Fargate.
VPC prepared for Fargate with a NAT Gateway and a private pod subnet
Private RDS MariaDB, security group scoped to the VPC CIDR
AWS Load Balancer Controller via an IRSA role limited to one service account
Frontend and API exposed through one multi-AZ ALB with path-based routing
